title: Fix README and write operator deployment runbook
description: README.md currently says 'planning phase — no code exists yet' which is false (16K LOC, 240+ tests, two working binaries). This epic updates the README to reflect actual project state and adds a deployment runbook covering: how to build both binaries, required config files, TLS cert setup, IPFS node requirements, operator key generation, and how to peer two transit instances. Why: a developer cloning the repo today sees a contradictory README and no deployment docs; this blocks any operator from running the system.
